es: Dar retroalimentación específica con un aspecto positivo, un punto de mejora y un siguiente paso expresado con estructuras causativas (have, get, make, let).

teaching.en: You were calm under pressure, and that made the team feel more confident.
teaching.es: Mantuviste la calma bajo presión y eso hizo que el equipo se sintiera más seguro.
teaching.explanationEs: Make + persona + verbo base: lo que tú haces provoca un efecto en otros.

teaching.en: Your passes are accurate; the next step is to look up before you pass.

teaching.en: I will have Tom show you a faster way to manage the queue.

teaching.en: If you get the new volunteers to sign in first, the queue will move faster.

teaching.explanationEs: Let me know + if: invita a la otra persona a decidir; fix es corregir un problema concreto.

prompt.es: Da feedback a Leo: un elogio, una mejora y un paso con have o get.

answer.text: Leo, thank you for your work at the registration table. You were calm under pressure, and that made the parents feel confident. You were also accurate with the names on the list. However, you spent too long with each family, so the queue became very long. The next step is simple: I will have Mia show you a faster system. You could also get the new volunteers to hand out the badges while you check the names. That would improve the timing, and you will be able to talk to more families. I am sure you can fix this by Saturday.
accepted: Leo, thank you for your work at the registration table. You were calm under pressure, and that made the parents feel confident. You were also accurate with the names on the list. However, you spent too long with each family, so the queue became very long. The next step is simple: I will have Mia show you a faster system. You could also get the new volunteers to hand out the badges while you check the names. That would improve the timing, and you will be able to talk to more families. I am sure you can fix this by Saturday.

Leo, well done at the registration table. You stayed calm, and that made the families feel safe. Your work with the names was very accurate. One thing to improve is the time you spend with each family, because the queue grew too long. The next step is to ask Mia for her system: I will have her show you this afternoon. Tomorrow, try to get the new volunteers to give out the badges while you check the names. That will improve your timing. I am sure you can fix it by Saturday.

Leo, I liked your work at the table. You were calm and friendly, and that made the parents feel safe. However, your timing needs work, because the queue was too long. The next step is to learn a quicker system, so I will have Mia show you hers. Next time, get the new volunteers to help you with the badges. That will let you talk to more families. Thank you, and let me know if you need help before Saturday.

feedback.es: El feedback completo une un elogio concreto, un punto de mejora y un paso con have o get, con un plazo y un tono amable.

origin.text: Leo atendió la mesa de inscripción: estuvo calmado y fue preciso con los nombres, pero tardó demasiado con cada familia y la cola creció. Escribe 80 a 120 palabras con tono amable, una sugerencia con have o get y un plazo.
